items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: my cousin, he used to play in Erskine Hawkin’s band... I always did idolize him

ctx.x: What led you to the trombone?

Well I’ve been trying to figure that out for a long time. Anyway, so what happened was I started out on drums first, because my cousin, he used to play in Erskine Hawkin’s band, you know, way before your time. And so I mean he idolized him. He used to come home with all different kinds of stories, I mean because went all over the state, in Alabama, you know. So he used to come back off the road and tell of the good times he had, and who he met and this and that. And I always did idolize him, you know, secretly…
my dad did. So I’ve been still trying to learn the darn thing, you know. It’s really something else.
